Message.Name: Broker Queue Message
Message.Description: The Broker Queue message contains the priority list of the (max) top 40 broker IDs for a given side, and is generated whenever any of the entries in the list are modified. Entries are ordered according to distance away from the best price. Spread level entries are marked with Type set to 'S'.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading.

Field.Name: ItemCount
Field.Description: Number of items in the message. 0 to 40.

Field.Name: BQSide
Field.Description: Side of the order (PDF field "Side"; renamed to BQSide to disambiguate from the Bid/Offer Side used in other order-book messages).

Field.Name: BQMoreFlag
Field.Description: Flag indicating if there are more broker numbers in the queue.

Field.Name: Item
Field.Description: Either the broker number or the number of spreads away from the best price.

Field.Name: Type
Field.Description: Indicates the type of information contained in the item.

Value.Name: More broker numbers exist in the queue
